title: Environmental Science, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Penn State Erie, The Behrend College. No University Park equivalent exists by this exact name -- UP's own Environmental Systems Engineering major (ENVSYS-2026.json, an EMS-college engineering degree) is a different program with a different name; UP does not offer a science-college 'Environmental Science, B.S.' at all. Built fresh from Behrend's own bulletin page (bulletins.psu.edu/undergraduate/colleges/behrend/environmental-science-bs/), Plan Code ENVSC_BS, minimum 121 credits. Two named options exist (Environmental Field Science, Environmental Lab Science); this plan models the Environmental Field Science Option specifically, using its own suggested academic plan almost verbatim. Several bulletin line items name a short closed list of real alternatives with no further narrative (e.g. 'GEOG 10, GEOSC 1, GEOSC 20, or EARTH 2'; 'PHIL 103, 119, or 132') -- these are modeled as multi-option course items exactly as listed. A few line items name only a generic category with no enumerated course list on the bulletin page itself (three 'Course Selection (N/PS or SSA/H)' picks, drawn from the school's Natural & Physical Sciences and Social Sciences/Arts/Humanities program lists) -- modeled as generic Supporting Course placeholder slots, the same convention used across every other plan in this repo for an unenumerated department list. The bulletin's own 'PHYS 211 or 250' / 'PHYS 212 or 251' choice is preserved as-is even though PHYS 212 itself only prereqs off PHYS 211, not PHYS 250 -- the paired item's own PHYS 251 alternative (which accepts either PHYS 211 or PHYS 250) covers the PHYS-250 branch, so the requirement is schedulable either way. Created a new envsc_catalog.json (ENVSC 200/400W/404/494/495/496) since no ENVSC department catalog existed in this repo before this pass; course descriptions and prerequisites for these sourced from bulletins.psu.edu's own ENVSC course-description page. The capstone ENVSC 400W has a real, demanding multi-course prereq chain per that same page (BIOL 402W, a 300/400-level GEOSC course, ENGL 202C, and a Political Science or Economics course) -- and BIOL 402W's own real catalog prereq (confirmed against biol_catalog.json) requires ALL of STAT 250, BIOL 220W, BIOL 230W, and BIOL 240W together, not just the single BIOL 220W the bulletin's own 'Additional Courses' line names. Two of those (BIOL 230W, BIOL 240W) were not otherwise part of this option's suggested plan; added explicitly (replacing two of the bulletin's four originally-generic 'Course Selection' picks) to keep ENVSC 400W schedulable rather than leaving the major's own capstone permanently blocked. Also fixed two 'or' choices that would have silently broken this same chain if the engine's ranked-option picker chose the other alternative: PLSC 1 (not ENVSC 200/SUST 200/CAS 222N/AYFCE 211N/CIVCM 211N) and STAT 250 (not STAT 200/SCM 200) are the specific real courses ENVSC 400W's own prereq group requires, so those items were narrowed to guarantee the capstone's prereqs are always actually satisfied. Post-prereq-chain fix (same real issue documented across every CHEM 110-requiring plan in this repo): CHEM 110's real prereq is MATH 22, which chains through MATH 21, MATH 4, and MATH 3 -- added explicitly (Semester 1: MATH 3/4; Semester 2: MATH 21/22); max_credits_per_semester set to 18 for the same reason as every other such plan.
